profiles.description: Payments in advance at the beginning of each period. The first rental instalment is paid immediately at commencement, before using the equipment.
Payments in arrears at the end of each period. The first rental instalment is due only after the first full period of equipment use.

requests.note: Rent is payable in advance at the start of every month. First payment is collected immediately when the rental begins.
Rental payments are made in arrears at each month end, after equipment use. First instalment falls one month after commencement.
Pay on commencement and then on the first day of each subsequent period. These are beginning-of-period payments.
